title: More reliable update checks
summary: Update checks allow more time for GitHub to respond, show clearer errors, and include copyable debug details to help troubleshoot connection problems.

items: Increased the update check timeout from 20 to 60 seconds to accommodate slower connections and GitHub download redirects.
Fixed connection failures being incorrectly reported as unreadable update information because the error contained the latest.json URL.
Updated release links and the fallback updater configuration to use the current scribe-notes repository.
Failed update checks now include expandable debug details in About, showing the endpoint, elapsed time, failure category and underlying native errors.
Added a Copy debug details button. Reports stay in the app until copied and redact URL credentials, query tokens, email addresses and Windows user-directory names.
Timeouts now receive a specific explanation instead of a generic update information error.
